name: Grimas Infused Preroll | Pink Starburst
description: Grimas 1.5g Double Infused Pre Rolls are a high end, top shelf experience crafted for elevated potency and bold flavor. Infused with rich terpene distillate and THCA, they deliver a smooth, slow burning smoke with powerful effects and premium quality in every roll.
